item.title: Stephens County Christian Learning Center moving to Big A Road this Summer - WNEG
item.description: The Stephens County Christian Learning Center is moving to a new facility on Big A Road this summer, says executive director Joan Wanner. The Stephens County Christian Learning Center offers middle and high school students supplemental education on the Bible and its teachings. [...]

item.title: Every Stephens County Student is a CTAE Student - WNEG
item.description: Every student in the Stephens County School System is a CTAE student, explains Joni Whitfield, CTAE Director for Stephens County Schools. CTAE stands for Career, Technical, and Agriculture Educational Center, which offers classes in automotive, business, construction, cosmetology, drafting, broadcast video production, nursing, and welding.
